SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.user_no, u.user_real_cn_name, u.user_real_en_name, u.user_sex, u.user_email, u.user_mobile,u.user_tag,u.qq,u.weixin, u.expire_policy, u.be_multi_login,u.point_tag, u.expire_time, u.create_time, u.create_user_cn_name, u.state, u.avatar, u.note,u.be_lock, CONCAT(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.role_name)) AS userRoles, CONCAT(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.id)) AS userRoleIds, CONCAT(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT g.group_name)) AS userGroups,CONCAT(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT g.id)) AS userGroupIds, CONCAT(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT g1.group_name)) AS userParentGroups, CONCAT(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ut.uset_name)) AS userSets, CONCAT(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.post_name)) AS userPosts FROM sys_user AS u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role AS ur ON u.id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role AS r ON ur.role_id = r.id and r.be_default = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user_group ug ON ug.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_group g ON g.id = ug.group_id LEFT JOIN sys_group g1 on g1.id = substr(g.parent_id, 1, 3) LEFT JOIN sys_user_position up on up.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_position p on p.id = up.position_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_uset us on us.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_uset ut on ut.id = us.uset_id
AND u.user_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{user.userName,jdbcType=CHAR},'%')
AND u.user_real_cn_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{user.userRealCnName,jdbcType=CHAR},'%')
AND u.user_mobile LIKE CONCAT('%',#{user.userMobile,jdbcType=CHAR},'%')
AND u.user_email LIKE CONCAT('%',#{user.userEmail,jdbcType=CHAR},'%')
AND u.state = #{user.state,jdbcType=CHAR}
AND r.role_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{user.roleName,jdbcType=CHAR},'%')
AND g.group_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{user.departName,jdbcType=CHAR},'%')
AND g1.group_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{user.companyName,jdbcType=CHAR},'%')
AND p.post_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{user.postName,jdbcType=CHAR},'%')
AND u.user_tag LIKE CONCAT('%',#{user.userTag,jdbcType=CHAR},'%')

AND g.id IS NULL
